id./param/scenario/cs/b_080_cs_200.pack|cs_: "Gehehehehe... Delicious, delicious...
"I am the Gloomnivore. Devourer of despair...
"His kingdom ruined, loved ones dead, this man's despair is a gourmet full course.
"Such despair is rare. So I show him that nightmare of sixteen years ago again and again, and keep eating.
"This man's despair is unforgettable. Sixteen years of eating and I never tire. But...
"I wanted to try another flavor. Next, I'll feast on your fresh despair!
"Now feel it. The sorrowful cry of your heart.
"This is the most hated memory in your heart.
"Your power was stolen, and you gave birth to the Lord of Shadows. And so this world broke.
"You protected no one. You could not save the world. That is the sin of a powerless Luminary.
"Fall into the darkness of despair you cannot resist. It will be my food...
...{var:1}. Can you hear me, {var:1}?
{var:1}... The holy light within you will never go out.
That light quietly awaits the time to awaken within you. To light the world again!
Only you, the Luminary, can destroy the darkness! Now, awaken...!!
"W-What is this light...! Aaaaagh!!
"Wh-What? What happened!?
"Oh, {var:1}! Thank goodness. You're safe...
"Gwaaah...! That detestable light blinds me...!
"You are the root of it all! {var:1}, let's defeat this thing and free King Irwin from the curse!"
